reports.name: Product roadmap
reports.definition_of_done:
No single repo-wide end state exists. Five documents each define one, and they do not agree:
(1) docs/audits/2026-09-completion-roadmap.md: the objective is a "Runtime capable of autonomous self-extensions and validation with built-in agents, maintaining PRODUCT/CORE separation". Done means M6, "Commercial Claims Unlocked": M1 to M5 closed, legal, privacy and security sign-offs, collateral, a public launch and a first enterprise customer on autonomous Tier 0 (lines 626-630). M7, the Learning Harness, comes after M6 (lines 783-790).
(2) CONTINUITY.md §1: a "development tool + runtime for governed, cryptographically certified AI/agentic applications — CLI and GUI, targeting AWS, Azure, and native platforms, with an optional self-extending runtime". §5 lists the roadmap beyond mesh slice 5.
(3) docs/marketing/product-boundary.md: the core is "governs behavior, not intelligence". The live path is embed → gate → package → receipts → design partner. "Autonomy is not required for the company to succeed." Autonomy, Learn, Cloud PAYG and Forge GA are on HOLD.
(4) docs/ProductsAndBusinessPlan.md §5.3 sets year-one outcomes (3-5 paying organisations across two SKUs). docs/ProductFleetImplementationRoadmap.md sets phase exits: first paying Private customer, then Cloud, Enterprise, Automation, Mesh.
(5) Epics #539/#540/#541: share and mesh are done only with dated dogfood E2E evidence. Cloud PAYG is roadmap only. The GUI is optional.
This assessment scores against the completion roadmap's milestone exit checkboxes (the only countable end state), the product-fleet phase tables and the epic done-when lines.

On landed evidence, 1 of 5 unlock criteria is met (criterion 2). Criterion 1 is partly met. 3a, 3b and 4 are not met, so marketing HOLD is correct.

The ledger's newest row is 2026-09-25. Those nine fixture PASS rows (landed in #654) meet threshold 1: 9/10 = 90% with the 2026-09-14 GAP row counted. They also meet threshold 2: mean 17.7s (13.9-18.7s) to CertifiedButHeld. Threshold 3 (rejection rate) was never measured. Threshold 4 (7 consecutive days) has nine consecutive weekday PASS rows, but no review of all thresholds is recorded.

Since the scorecard was last edited (2026-09-27), master gained the 3a mechanics:
- #665 (755cf6101): the sweep persists its record, re-reads it and verifies it under Strict, above the hold;
- #661 (615728b7a): operator-configurable pinning;
- #655: a sweep that reaches no verdict no longer exits 0.

Since 2026-09-29, 13 CI runs (11 scheduled dates through 2026-10-13) each emit a re-verified record citation (signer=ephemeral CI key, pinned=false, dev-hmac=true). That would satisfy 3a's count, but none is landed. 16 runs are unlanded in all, their records survive only in 30-day artifacts, and the first ones expire 2026-10-29. Landing also waits on an owner decision: whether the record JSON gets committed.

3b has no attended run. The identity bridge (OperatorCertificationIdentity, DECISION-identity-split.md step 3) is not in src.

Criterion 4 has no mechanism: there is no PR-producing path in the product loop, and admission is held.

Every one of the 25 CI runs replayed the recorded proposal rather than a live model, and the ledger rows don't say so. Thresholds 1-3 therefore measure re-certifying a fixed qwen3.8:27b proposal, not proposer behaviour.

The scorecard's status section, the cheat sheet and LearningHarness.md are out of date. Two criteria carry false ✅ marks.
